tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}

Source: topping:page-0056 1. ch4:2.2\group topping-pde-existence For the Laplace--Beltrami operator, \[ \Delta =\frac{1}{\sqrt g}\partial _i\bigl(\sqrt g\, g^{ij}\partial _j\bigr) =g^{ij}\partial _i\partial _j+\text{lower order terms}, \qquad g=\det (g_{ij}), \] one has \[ \sigma (\Delta )(x,\xi )=g^{ij}\xi _i\xi _j=\lvert \xi \rvert ^2>0. \] Thus the heat equation defined by this operator is parabolic. \end{example}
